lines: 【御兽文，已百万字养肥，可宰，帅哥里面请】
黑凉国，界海，神秘荒岛。
青石垒砌的巨型黑屋里，三百多名少年男女蜷缩在墙角，衣衫褴褛，个个眼神空洞，活像一群没有生气的腐朽木偶。
“咔嚓！”
伴随一阵低沉轰鸣，闭合的石门缓缓打开。
光，渗透而入，留下斑驳印痕。
屋内众男女回过神，神情麻木的望向屋外。
走进屋内的，是一名身穿黑袍、面戴猪首面具的瘦竹竿男人。
高瘦男人如鬼魅般伫立门口，阴翳的目光于众人脸上巡视。
片刻，嘶哑声音骤响，“小黑屋三百名蛊虫，今日只能活二…”
话语未落，屋内的少年男女动了，纷纷抄起身边石头、打磨的锋锐骨棒，杀向身边人！
一时，屋内陷入惨烈厮杀。
哀嚎、求饶，咒骂，不绝于耳。
面具男人抱臂冷漠旁观，身体因兴奋而颤抖。
似乎颇为享受。
百余呼吸后，望着尸横满地的石屋，他轻轻拍了拍手掌，“停。”
幸存下来的少年男女动作一顿，机械般重回原位。
三百余人，如今，只剩下二百人。
“不错，你们很不错，一个月时间，能从千人中脱颖而出，足以证明你们这批小蛊虫能力。”
“明日开始，我将为你们举行御兽师天赋测试。”
“同时，并协助你们契约人生中的第一只御兽。”
道完，面具男人再次扫视屋内众人，轻笑离去。
厚重石门闭合，屋内重新陷入昏暗死寂…
“我，我想回家…谁能来救救我…我什么都愿意做。”
场中，传来哭泣声，一名坐在地上的少女再也支撑不住，泪眼朦胧，怀抱双膝放声大哭。
哭泣像是能传染，迅速蔓延至在场的每一人…
为心头，染上抹挥之不去的阴霾。
一个月前，这小黑屋内，一千人只能活五百人，半个月前，五百只能活三百，今天又是三百人只能活二百。
以后呢？
二百活一百，一百活五十？五十活十？十活一？
前所未有的压迫下，有人精神崩溃，起身放声大笑，踉跄着一头撞向石壁。
二百人，只剩一百九十九人…

Heiliang Country, Boundary Sea, Mysterious Desert Island.
In a giant black room made of bluestone, more than three hundred young men and women huddled in the corner. They were all dressed in ragged clothes and had empty eyes, like a group of lifeless, decaying puppets.
"Crack!"
With a low roar, the closed stone door slowly opened.
Light penetrates in, leaving mottled marks.
The men and women in the room came to their senses and looked outside the room with numb expressions.
The person who walked into the house was a thin bamboo man wearing a black robe and a pig head mask.
The tall and thin man stood at the door like a ghost, his dark eyes scanning everyone's faces.
After a moment, a hoarse voice suddenly sounded, "There are three hundred Gu insects in the small black room, and only two can survive today..."
Before the words were finished, the young men and women in the room started to move. They picked up the stones and sharpened bone sticks around them and started killing the people around them!
For a moment, the house fell into a violent fight.
Wailing, begging for mercy, and cursing are endless.
The masked man folded his arms and watched indifferently, his body trembling with excitement.
He seemed to enjoy it quite a bit.
After more than a hundred breaths, he looked at the stone house with corpses strewn on the ground, and gently clapped his hands and said, "Stop."
The surviving young men and women paused and returned to their original positions mechanically.
There were more than 300 people, but now, only 200 are left.
"Yes, you are very good. You can stand out from thousands of people in one month, which is enough to prove the ability of you little Gu bugs."
"Starting tomorrow, I will conduct a beast master talent test for you."
"At the same time, I will assist you in contracting the first beast in your life."
After finishing speaking, the masked man glanced at everyone in the room again, chuckled and left.
"Click!"
The thick stone door closed, and the room fell into darkness and silence again...
"I, I want to go home...Who can come and save me...I'm willing to do anything."
“…”
There were sounds of crying in the field. A girl sitting on the ground could no longer hold on. Her eyes were filled with tears, and she hugged her knees and cried loudly.
Crying seems to be contagious and quickly spreads to everyone present...
For the heart, stained with lingering haze.
A month ago, in this small dark room, one thousand people could only live five hundred. Half a month ago, five hundred could only live three hundred. Today, three hundred people could only live two hundred.
What next?
Two hundred to live to one hundred, one hundred to live to fifty? Fifty live ten? One out of ten?
Under the unprecedented pressure, some people had a nervous breakdown, stood up, laughed loudly, staggered and hit the stone wall.
"Crack!"
Two hundred people, only one hundred and ninety-nine left...
